summary.text: Hugh Hyder-Darlington is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 98 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent against Republican Nicky Woods and independent Joshua Deering.
A retired U.S. Navy veteran, he says he began his civic life as a Republican before becoming a Democrat.

paragraphs.text: Hugh Hyder-Darlington served in the U.S. Navy from 1977 to 1983.
He graduated from Northern Chester County Vo-Tech and earned a bachelor's degree from Penn State University in 1983, and he is retired.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a veteran, husband, father and grandfather.
Hyder-Darlington advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In the survey he said he started his civic life as a Republican but that "the party left me," and that he then became a Democrat.
He listed strong public schools and career pathways, affordable health care, agriculture, veterans, working families and small businesses among his priorities.
